rule dac_az_0030 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "Azure: PIM Azure resource role activation anomalous - PIM resource role activate"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-AZ-0030"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1548.005"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_ACTIVITY"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = /(?:roleAssignmentSchedule|PIM)/ nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignmentScheduleRequests/write" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
